name: FieldSeasonCropPlanner
tagline: Plan every field for next harvest – rotation-checked, seed-counted and approved.
description: A complete seasonal cropping-plan app for Power Apps and Power Pages: rotation grid of fields × seasons, rotation rules with override approval, planting windows, seed requirement and bags, area totals by crop and variety, plan versions with comparison, approval and roll-forward.
features: Rotation rules: minimum seasons per crop group, max consecutive cereals, second-crop warning
Crops that pass the rules suggested in the form
Seed requirement, bags and seed order JSON
Plan versions: compare, copy, approve with supersede, roll forward
Undo, validation, read-only and disabled states
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: FieldSeasonCropPlanner data-set, FieldSeasonCropPlannerPortal field)
